name: SP-12 boom-bap head-nodder
desc: Classic SP-12 lo-fi boom-bap harvested from the stage-proven 808 hiphop scene: ghost-kick before the snare, triplet-shuffled hats with ghost-note gains, offbeat open hat breathing on a 4-bar mask, clap euclid walking across phrases.

code.sparse: stack(s("bd ~ ~ <~ [~ bd]> ~ ~ ~ ~").bank("EmuSP12").gain(${gain}).shape(.25), s("~ ~ ~ ~ sd ~ ~ ~").bank("EmuSP12").gain(${gain}*.7).room(${room}), s("[hh@2 hh]*2").bank("EmuSP12").gain(.28).lpf(sine.range(1800, ${cut}).slow(32))).every(8, x=>x.rev).fast(${rate}).orbit(1).play()
code.full: stack(s("bd ~ ~ [~ bd] ~ bd ~ ~").bank("EmuSP12").gain(${gain}).shape(.3).every(8, x=>x.fast(2)), s("~ ~ sd ~ ~ ~ sd <~ [~ sd]>").bank("EmuSP12").gain(${gain}*.8).room(${room}), s("[hh@2 hh]*4").bank("EmuSP12").gain("[.5 .26 .38]*4").lpf(sine.range(2200, ${cut}).slow(32)).pan(sine.range(.42,.58).slow(13)).rarely(x=>x.ply(2)), s("~ ~ ~ oh ~ ~ ~ ~").bank("EmuSP12").gain(.42).mask("<1 1 1 0>")).fast(${rate}).orbit(1).play()
code.peak: stack(s("bd ~ [~ bd] bd ~ bd ~ ~").bank("EmuSP12").gain(${gain}).shape(.35).every(4, x=>x.fast(2)), s("~ ~ sd ~ ~ ~ sd [~ sd]").bank("EmuSP12").gain(${gain}*.85).room(${room}).lastOf(8, x=>x.ply(2)), s("hh*8").bank("EmuSP12").gain("[.55 .3 .42 .26]*2").late("[0 .02]*4").lpf(sine.range(3000, ${cut}).slow(16)), s("~ ~ ~ oh").bank("EmuSP12").gain(.45), s("cp(3,8,<0 2 4 6>)").bank("RolandTR707").gain(.3).room(.4)).fast(${rate}).orbit(1).play()
